test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All fingers are thumbs.

Some thumbs are trees.

Some angles are trees.

**Conclusions:**

I : Some angles are thumbs.

II : Some trees are fingers.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Either conclusion I or II follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e5f02f8efce3f80c12fb36cc384918e440520149a25121bb24ef612a5cd0d55.png] 

Conclusions:

I : Some angles are thumbs - **FALSE **(Because no direct relation is given between angles and thumbs, so it may be a possibility but not definite)

II : Some trees are fingers -** FALSE **(Because some thumbs are tress and all fingers are thumbs, but some tress are also angles so it may be a possibility but not definite).

So, **Neither conclusion I nor II follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 2".**
